negative.sql:
SELECT name, count_of_visits
FROM (SELECT person.name, COUNT(*) AS count_of_visits
      FROM person_visits
      JOIN person ON person.id = person_visits.person_id
      GROUP BY person.id, person.name
      ORDER BY count_of_visits DESC, person.name ASC
      LIMIT 3) AS top
ORDER BY name;

negative.why: результат отсортирован по количеству, а не по имени
